cards.p: If advertising may take half the contribution, your ceiling is $0.50 per click: $6.25 of ad spend per sale, and $6.25 of profit.
Pay the $1.35 suggestion instead and a sale costs $1.35 multiplied by 12.5 clicks, or $16.88 against $12.50 of contribution: a loss of $4.38 per unit.
Amazon's published limit for up and down is the 100% in that table. A $0.50 bid can therefore compete at up to $1.00 — the break-even price above, and twice the ceiling you set.
Amazon allows an adjustment of up to 900% on each, for all targeting types and all bidding strategies. It multiplies the bid you entered, for that placement only.
